blurb: Experience a captivating private 2-day sightseeing tour of the Coromandel Peninsula, departing from Hamilton. On this exclusive adventure, you'll journey through stunning scenic landscapes, lush farmland, dramatic gorges, enchanting waterfalls, picturesque coastline and native bush, all while enjoying the comfort of personalized attention. This two-day tour offers the perfect blend of adventure, relaxation, and exhilarating exploration of one of New Zealand’s most beautiful regions. Accommodation and meals are tailored to your preferences, ensuring a personalized experience. Please note that these are not included in the tour price and will be arranged separately.
